project.green-api-description: A web chat for the MAX messenger using GREEN-API, built as a test assignment. You can connect your account, start a chat by phone number, send and receive text messages, and view conversation history.
project.personal-blog-description: A personal blog built with Vue.js, TypeScript and Supabase. Supports Markdown posts and an admin panel for creating and editing publications.
project.mini-crm-description: A CRM for a construction company, built with React, TypeScript and Supabase. Managers organize construction sites and assign tasks, while assignees track their work and submit it for review. Includes a task board, revision workflow and status history.
project.local-file-share-description: An educational application built with C# and Avalonia for sharing files and text over a local network. Its custom UDP-based protocol supports device discovery, packet acknowledgements and retries, file transfer resumption and SHA-256 integrity checks.
project.alfa-hack-description: A business lending portal built by APOHU Team at Alfa Hack 2026. Entrepreneurs can submit a loan application, see why it was declined, provide more information for reassessment, and compare personalized offers with AI-assisted recommendations. Bank staff review applications and see check results and decision history, while administrators configure the credit scoring model. Built with React, TypeScript, Spring Boot and FastAPI.
